data.name: Tears Revolude
data.detailed_description:
A classic command-based RPG with 3D map interface and smooth battle animation!

Story

A century ago, there was a unique artist named Orwiel. Sion and Michelle set off on a journey to discover his final works. The two meet a girl with no memories named Liara. What the girl carries will shake both the path they travel and their fate!

A mainstream command RPG with a 3D map interface!

Begin a new adventure in this game's 3D dungeons! This game uses old-school command-based battles to bring you an easily understood and played mainstream command RPG.

Impressive battle animation!

Finely-drawn enemies, smooth motion, and screen-filling effects let you experience impressive scenes of battle!

Enhance your weapon and learn new skills

Keep using your skills to make them more powerful! Go to the blacksmith in town to enhance your characters' weapons and learn new skills. Each character can learn up to five skills. As you use these skills, the nature of their attacks and power will change. Keep using them in order to deal massive damage!

Store SP in order to unleash special abilities!

Build your SP gauge in battle and use it to unleash special abilities! The gauge has a maximum of four levels, and by using it all at once, your allies can join in to create an even more powerful attack.

About KEMCO

KEMCO is a video game publishing company specializing in handheld JRPG games. By focusing on immersive narratives and quality gameplay we strive to continually design gaming experiences both seasoned and new gamers alike can enjoy while advancing the genre to a whole new level.

*IMPORTANT NOTICE*
This app features full controller support with the Xbox 360 Controller on Windows. Full controller support is not guaranteed on Mac OS X.

reviews.review:
Developed by WorldWideSoftware and published by KEMCO, Tears Revolude is a fantasy role-playing adventure that embraces the timeless appeal of classic Japanese RPGs while introducing several mechanics that help distinguish it from similar titles. The game follows Sion and Michelle, two adventurers searching for the final creations of the legendary artist Orwiel, whose unfinished legacy has fascinated the world for generations. Their expedition takes an unexpected turn when they encounter Liara, a mysterious young woman who has lost her memories. As her forgotten past gradually resurfaces, the trio becomes entangled in a larger conflict filled with hidden truths, forgotten history, and revelations that reshape the purpose of their journey. The story unfolds at a measured pace, allowing players to become invested in both the central mystery and the relationships between the main characters.

Narrative progression is one of the game's strongest qualities. Rather than relying solely on dramatic twists, the story steadily builds momentum by introducing new locations, memorable supporting characters, and clues that deepen the mystery surrounding Liara and Orwiel's legacy. Familiar themes such as friendship, sacrifice, and destiny are woven naturally into the adventure, giving the narrative a comforting sense of familiarity without making it feel entirely predictable. Character interactions also contribute significantly to the experience, as the party gradually develops stronger bonds while facing increasingly dangerous challenges. Although the plot follows conventions that longtime JRPG fans will recognize, it remains engaging because of its consistent pacing and genuine emotional moments.

Combat stays true to the traditional turn-based formula but introduces enough strategic depth to remain enjoyable throughout the campaign. Battles encourage players to carefully manage skills, resources, and timing instead of simply repeating the strongest attacks. A unique progression system allows abilities to become more powerful the more frequently they are used, rewarding experimentation and giving every character room to develop according to the player's preferred style. Weapon upgrades obtained through the blacksmith further expand customization, providing meaningful incentives to improve equipment and unlock additional combat potential. These interconnected systems create satisfying character growth without overwhelming players with unnecessary complexity.

Another highlight is the SP mechanic, which adds an extra layer of tactical decision-making during encounters. Players accumulate SP while fighting and must decide whether to spend it on immediate advantages or save it for powerful combination techniques that can dramatically shift difficult battles. These cooperative attacks create exciting moments during boss encounters and reinforce teamwork among party members. Outside of combat, players explore dungeons presented through a fully navigable 3D environment filled with treasure, enemies, and opportunities to strengthen the party. Exploration remains straightforward and accessible, allowing the focus to remain on storytelling and progression while still rewarding careful observation.

Visually, Tears Revolude presents an attractive fantasy world despite its modest production scale. Character portraits, enemy artwork, spell animations, and environmental designs create a colorful atmosphere that captures the spirit of classic role-playing games. The soundtrack complements the adventure with a collection of melodic themes that effectively enhance emotional scenes, peaceful exploration, and intense confrontations. While the graphics do not aim for cutting-edge realism, they possess a charming style that fits the game's nostalgic direction. The interface is equally functional, making inventory management, combat commands, and navigation easy to understand even for newcomers to the genre.

Tears Revolude succeeds because it understands exactly what kind of experience it wants to deliver. It does not chase modern trends or overly complicated mechanics, instead focusing on a compelling story, reliable turn-based combat, and rewarding character progression. Some players may find its structure familiar and certain gameplay loops repetitive over extended sessions, but these shortcomings are balanced by an engaging mystery, polished combat systems, and an enjoyable sense of adventure. Fans of classic JRPGs looking for a traditional fantasy journey with meaningful progression and memorable characters will find plenty to appreciate. It stands as another solid entry in KEMCO's catalog, offering an entertaining adventure that respects the foundations of the genre while adding enough originality to remain worthwhile from beginning to end.

Rating: 5/10
